table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname= item.name,
	department = dbo.department.name,
	salesman = dbo.users.username, 
	Receiptinvcode = dbo.Receiptheader.Receiptinvcode, 
	smanname=salesman.name, 
	date = dbo.Receiptheader.date,   
	price = Case (Select DBO.FN_Get_INT_Preference('ReceiptPriceInPrint')) When 1 THEN receiptdetail.saleprice When 2 THEN receiptdetail.purchaseprice When 3 THEN receiptdetail.avgprice When 4 THEN receiptdetail.MRPP END,
	dbo.Receiptheader.deptcode,
	dbo.Receiptheader.remarks,	
	gcode = Receiptdetail.gcode,   
	icode = Receiptdetail.icode,   
	batch = Receiptdetail.batch,   
	expiry = Receiptdetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = Receiptdetail.qty,
	referenceno=dbo.Receiptheader.referenceno,
	dbo.Receiptheader.referencedate,
	Godown = Godown.name,
	itempacking = itempacking.name
FROM 
	Receiptheader
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.salesman ON (dbo.Receiptheader.Smancode = dbo.SalesMan.Salesmancode),
	Receiptdetail, 
	users, 
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Godown ON (dbo.item.gcode = dbo.Godown.gcode),
	department
WHERE 
	( dbo.Receiptheader.referenceno = :ar_refno ) AND
	( dbo.Receiptheader.Receiptinvcode = dbo.Receiptdetail.Receiptinvcode) AND
	( dbo.Receiptheader.deptcode = dbo.department.deptcode ) AND 
	( dbo.Receiptheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.Receiptdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)
ORDER BY
	dbo.Receiptheader.Receiptinvcode,
	item.name

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( Round ( price * qty , 2 ) for group 1 ) , 0  )
